title: Answer: consciousness does not need life

statements.text: Consciousness does not depend on life: the cosmos is conscious, and on Shani and Keppler’s view every quantum system is. Keppler and Shani note growing evidence of cognition in brainless organisms, slime molds, bacteria and plants, which presses against the view that consciousness and its neural correlates are coextensive.
